classifications.statement: Calculation-method details identify the required birth inputs, reference data, and uncertainty limits.
Houses, aspects, and natal-chart vocabulary are identified as Western astrology conventions.
Symbolic meanings remain reflective possibilities and do not establish personality, fate, or professional conclusions.
Adult symbolic reflection and private ritual space.
The documented product method keeps deterministic draws or calculations separate from explanatory prose.
The user keeps control of the question, meaning, intention, small action, and decision to revisit.
Calculation rules and worked examples follow the published V1 date-reduction method.
Number meanings are optional symbolic prompts, not measured traits, identity claims, or predictions.
Private questions, journals, prayers, intentions, and birth details are excluded from public pages and routine analytics.
These are original secular digital reflection patterns, not claims of inherited religious authority or stronger spiritual efficacy.
Prompts and symbolic actions are optional aids for reflection; the user chooses their own meaning and next step.
The public safety boundary excludes professional determinations, guaranteed outcomes, fear-based claims, and paid spiritual efficacy.
Reflective language describes possibilities and limitations rather than certainty about a person or future event.
Card names, order, orientation vocabulary, and symbolic associations come from the reviewed Major Arcana catalog.
Possibilities, tensions, questions, and small actions are editorial reflection prompts rather than factual predictions.
